description: Run SpectrophotometricFluxCalibration: writes the flux metadata that run_mgc requires. The image must be plate-solved and linear. Needs the camera QE curve (default "Ideal QE curve"; pass qe_name for the real sensor, see find_filters) and the filter curve. MONO image: pass filter (L, R, G, B, Ha, OIII, SII) and optionally filter_name (a measured curve from the database; otherwise a flat passband from wavelength_nm/bandwidth_nm is used). COLOR image: omit filter and pass red_filter_name, green_filter_name, blue_filter_name (otherwise flat R/G/B passbands).

bandwidth_nm.description: Mono: filter bandwidth in nm, if filter_name is not given

blue_filter_name.description: Color: measured B filter curve name from find_filters

filter.description: Mono only. One of L, R, G, B, Ha, OIII, SII

filter_name.description: Mono: measured filter curve name from find_filters

green_filter_name.description: Color: measured G filter curve name from find_filters

qe_name.description: Camera QE curve name (default "Ideal QE curve")

red_filter_name.description: Color: measured R filter curve name from find_filters

wavelength_nm.description: Mono: filter center wavelength in nm, if filter_name is not given

name: run_spfc
